notes: Two ASV Hebrew-gloss notes ('that which is decreed', 'all the sons of affliction') read and set aside under rule 38.

The competing division of 'any that is afflicted' across כֹּל / בְּנֵי / עֳנִי is named in the unit notes under rule 8: כֹּל holds the recast relational 'due to' with its own 'any' under rule 19, בְּנֵי is left unrendered under rule 22, and the recast noun takes the supplied relative and copula under rules 46 and 20.
This divides the same construction as PRO.31.8 by counting the ASV's words against the morphemes present, rather than by importing that verse's allocation.
